title: Short Horizons and Sparse Concepts: a Mathematical View of the Readout in the J-lens
abstract: arXiv:2608.25347v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Jacobian lens (J-lens) has been proposed as a way to read verbalizable representations from language models. However, its principle and meaning lack a detailed and theoretical discussion. We provide a mathematical view of this interpretation and of its assumed causal structure. Besides treating the J-lens as a heuristic probe, we further regard it as a first-order causal transfer operator from intermediate activations to expected future readouts. We study the Jacobian matrix as the optimal local linear approximation of the downstream mapping, analyze its global approximation behavior and bias, and identify its mathematical meaning as an expectation over anticipated future readouts. Further analysis of the Jacobian energy distribution reveals that its causal geometry is highly sparse. The energy decays with depth, concentrates in an extremely small proportion, and decomposes into diagonal pathways and specific critical positions. This

translated_title: 短视界与稀疏概念：J-lens中读出机制的数学视角
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25347v1 公告类型：新 摘要：Jacobian透镜（J-lens）被提出作为一种从语言模型中读取可言语化表示的方法。然而，其原理和意义缺乏详细的理论讨论。我们为这种解释及其假定的因果结构提供了数学视角。除了将J-lens视为启发式探针外，我们进一步将其视为从中间激活到预期未来读出的一阶因果转移算子。我们研究Jacobian矩阵作为下游映射的最优局部线性近似，分析其全局近似行为和偏差，并将其数学意义识别为对预期未来读出的期望。对Jacobian能量分布的进一步分析表明，其因果几何高度稀疏。能量随深度衰减，集中在极小的比例中，并分解为对角路径和特定关键位置。
tldr: 本文从数学上揭示了J-lens作为因果转移算子的本质，证明其Jacobian能量分布高度稀疏且随深度集中衰减，从而阐明了语言模型读出机制的短视界特性。
en_tdlr: This paper mathematically reveals the J-lens as a causal transfer operator, showing its Jacobian energy distribution is highly sparse and concentrates with depth, thereby elucidating the short-horizon nature of readout mechanisms in language models.
